fusion._doc: Forward-backward averaging (Luo et al. 2024 MPB 207:116808): combined = sqrt(backward_rel * forward_rel), each normalised by the cluster maximum. Geometric mean penalises inconsistency in either direction. Tiers use absolute criteria so a weak field of candidates does not produce a 'strong' suspect.
fusion._bwd_floor_why: exp(-2): at its best release age the vessel must lie within ~2 sigma(tau) of the drifted oil for backward support to count at all; relative rank alone can crown a vessel in a field with no real support. Fixed after the dev1 backward stage showed weak absolute densities, BEFORE any forward result existed.

age._doc: Slick age evidence (no validated SAR-only age estimator exists; report an interval). Width diffusion t=((W/4)^2 - s0^2)/(2K) for K in the diffusivity range; Okubo 1971 sigma_rc^2[cm2]=0.0108 t[s]^2.34; forward best release window of consistent vessels; persistence prior.
